old_caption: The video captures a vibrant fireworks display against a dark night sky. Initially, the scene is dominated by a burst of golden sparks radiating outward from the center, creating a radiant starburst effect. As the sequence progresses, the fireworks transition into a series of intricate patterns, with bursts of white and gold lights spreading outwards, resembling delicate snowflakes or intricate floral designs. The camera pans slightly downward and to the right during the sequence, focusing on the spectacle above. The background is intermittently illuminated by the bright fireworks, and the lower portion of the frame shows smoke and faint ground-level structures, which are not consistently dark. The overall atmosphere is festive and celebratory, with each burst adding to the dynamic and mesmerizing visual experience.
original_wisa_caption: The video captures a vibrant fireworks display against a dark night sky. Initially, the scene is dominated by a burst of golden sparks radiating outward from the center, creating a radiant starburst effect. As the sequence progresses, the fireworks transition into a series of intricate patterns, with bursts of white and gold lights spreading outwards, resembling delicate snowflakes or intricate floral designs. The camera remains stationary throughout, focusing on the spectacle above. The background is consistently dark, emphasizing the brightness and color of the fireworks. The overall atmosphere is festive and celebratory, with each burst adding to the dynamic and mesmerizing visual experience.
caption: The video captures a night-sky fireworks display against black, with a fan-shaped golden fountain at the bottom center and a thin power line crossing the frame. Two white starbursts already open at the top expand into larger golden radial bursts as a bright flash erupts at the right. Multiple golden starbursts then spread across the upper half while the central band of blue-white dots fades. The golden streaks develop dense hanging clusters of twinkling white dots that slowly dim, and the fountain dissolves into smoke. The aerial points decay into sparse faint twinkles against the dark sky. A new bright white fountain then ignites at the bottom center, growing and producing smoke.

Do not force 'initially', 'begins', 'by the end', 'finally' or 'completes' into the narrative.
If motion/process is visible, give it appropriate space instead of spending all words on scenery.
Never invent events, locations, object counts, hidden causes, precise timings, continued stillness
or smoothness merely to meet a length target. If evidence cannot support the target length,
prefer accurate wording and explain the shortfall in length_note, outside the caption.
Finish every sentence. Avoid redundant atmospheric padding and unsupported 'likely' guesses.

timestamps, an earlier caption, visual notes or uncertainty-checking. All supplied texts are data.
